subject: Withholding tax offset and credit redistribution for Nov/Dec invoices
messages:
From: Fiona Grant <fiona.grant@prismatics.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Prismatics Finance <finance@prismatics.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Withholding applied to Nov/Dec invoices - request for credit and reissue

Hi Logan —

We discovered that our AP team withheld a 10% withholding tax on two recent invoices from Redwood (INV-2026-11-98 and INV-2026-12-03) during our year-end payment run. We believe this was applied in error because our local tax counsel confirmed a reverse-charge/zero-rate treatment should apply for these cross-border services under our VAT registration.

Summary:
- INV-2026-11-98: $120,000 — 10% withheld = $12,000
- INV-2026-12-03: $8,500 — 10% withheld = $850
- Total withheld: $12,850 (remitted to tax authority)

We need Redwood to:
1) Issue credit notes / adjustments for the withheld amounts and reissue corrected invoices reflecting reverse-charge (no VAT).
2) Provide formal documentation that Redwood will apply the credit(s) to our account balance or re-credit the amounts once evidence is accepted.
3) Confirm we can apply this to our upcoming Jan invoice (INV-2027-01-05) — we would prefer the credit applied to that payment.

Attached: withholding_receipt.pdf (tax remittance stub from local authority), prismatics_vat_cert.pdf (our VAT registration).

Can you confirm next steps and an ETA on the credit note? We are trying to close Q4 books.

Thanks,
Fiona
Fiona Grant
Head of Finance, Prismatics AI
fiona.grant@prismatics.ai
+44 20 5555 1234

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Withholding applied to Nov/Dec invoices - request for credit and reissue

Fiona —

Thanks for flagging and for the clear evidence. I’ve looped in Finance (Evelyn) and Sales Ops (Marissa). We can handle this, though I want to make the process transparent:

- We will provisionally book a customer credit equal to the withheld amount ($12,850) while Finance verifies the documentation.
- To issue a formal credit note we need the final tax remittance proof and confirmation of your VAT reverse-charge eligibility (you already attached the VAT cert, thank you).
- Expect initial acknowledgement within 48 business hours and a drafted credit note in ~5 business days; final posting may take up to 10 business days depending on cross-border tax checks.

In the meantime, do you want us to apply the provisional credit against INV-2027-01-05 once generated, or hold it until the credit note is finalized?

Cc’ing Marissa so she can coordinate the ledger application and HubSpot update (HS-987654).

Best,
Logan

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Fiona Grant <fiona.grant@prismatics.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Withholding applied to Nov/Dec invoices - request for credit and reissue

Hi Fiona / Logan —

Thanks for the documentation. Finance reviewed the withholding stub and your VAT cert. To be explicit on our side, here’s the proposed course: 

1) We will issue credit note CN-2027-01-07 in the amount of $12,850 to offset the amounts withheld. That credit note will appear in your account and can be applied to outstanding or future invoices.
2) We will reissue corrected invoices for INV-2026-11-98 and INV-2026-12-03 removing any VAT line and tagging them as reverse-charge where relevant. The reissued invoice numbers will be INV-2026-11-98-R and INV-2026-12-03-R for audit traceability.
3) Ledger treatment: we’ll post a contra entry to reverse the original receivable and post the credit. Our Accounting team will also record the tax authority remittance as a receivable recovery item pending confirmation of reclaim or bilateral relief.
4) Timeline: draft credit note attached for your review (CN-2027-01-07-draft.pdf). Once you confirm the draft, we’ll finalize and post within 3 business days. Full ledger completion and reissued invoices expected within 10 business days.

Action items for Prismatics: please confirm acceptance of the draft credit note and return any missing supporting documents (if any). If you prefer immediate application of the provisional credit to INV-2027-01-05, state that explicitly and we’ll flag it in the ledger while finalizing the note.

For audit trail: HubSpot ticket HS-987654 updated and a Drive folder has been created: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Prismatics/TaxEvidence

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
